# Oraxol — Replication Tasks & Design Notes

## Source Reference

- **ColorLib Template:** Oraxol (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/oraxol/`)
- **Live Preview:** `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/oraxol/`
- **Assigned App Name:** `oraxol` (Package: `@free-react-templates/oraxol`)

## Section Breakdown & Structure

1. **Navbar:** Dark minimalist sticky header with brand logo and navigation links.
2. **Hero:** Centered bold headline, subtext, and "Available for freelance work" badge.
3. **Solutions / Services Grid:** 4-column feature cards (Graphic Design, Web Design, Branding & Printing, Web Development).
4. **Portfolio Section:** Grid of design project cards with image placeholders (`https://picsum.photos/seed/oraxol-work-<n>/600/400`).
5. **Testimonial Carousel:** Satisfied clients section with slider navigation.
6. **Team Grid:** Profiles of designers and developers.
7. **Blog Section:** Recent insights cards with author and comment metadata.
8. **Footer:** Multi-column footer with quick links, contact info, and mandatory Component Dock attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).
